scope: Native xMind bounded session history pages

implementation.storage: xlang3 SQLite query fetches at most limit+1 rows and returns the latest page in chronological order
implementation.compatibility: Existing /history route remains unchanged; this does not claim OpenCode operation parity or rendered UI adoption.

cases: three pages across a twelve-message transcript
chronological order and no-skip cursor continuation
HTTP and console CLI page equivalence
limit boundaries and unknown/duplicate query rejection

parity_limit: OpenCode typed message/part projection, type filter, selectable order, opaque cursor semantics, and rendered browser/VS Code history-page adoption remain incomplete.
